source.name: DP World Tour news: DP World signs long-term title partner extension with the DP World Tour

note: Title Partner and Official Logistics Partner of the DP World Tour until 2035; deal described as 'the largest in the Tour's history'; extends a title partnership begun in 2022 when the European Tour was renamed the DP World Tour. DP World also stays Title Partner of the season-ending DP World Tour Championship in Dubai until 2035 and becomes an Official Partner to a further 15 tournaments each season.
